name: Signpost
author: TammyX44
description: Names workspaces from their contents, shows agent and terminal command status, and adds a project switcher. Claude Code and trusted Codex hooks report permission requests directly. OpenCode 2.x support is experimental, and unread counts are opt-in.

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers with automatic names and agent status (replaces omarchy.workspaces)

schema.label: Bar · Names

options.label: Smart: projects, agents, hosts and web apps (plain apps show their logo)

schema.description: Smart keeps the bar's text for the things you named it for: a plain kitty, browser or editor with no project shows its number and logo.

schema.label: Bar · Shrink names to fit
schema.description: When names don't fit the room below, the least recently used shrink first: short name, then logo, then number.

options.label: Tiles: projects in their colour, apps on a neutral tile
Compact (smaller tiles; a tile replaces its number)

schema.label: Bar · Workspace numbers
schema.description: Off hides the number where a tile or name shows. Super + number still works, but you lose the reminder of which key is which.

schema.label: Bar · Extra counts
schema.description: Show the +N for other projects and enabled unread counts.

schema.label: Bar · Workspaces that only show their number
schema.description: Comma-separated workspace numbers as Hyprland counts them (on a second monitor: 11, 12…), e.g. 9, 10.

schema.label: Bar · Ignore these window classes
schema.description: Comma-separated. These windows never name a workspace.

schema.label: Agents · Status badge
schema.description: Show agent status on the tile. Terminal command badges have their own toggle.

schema.label: Agents · Badge shows
schema.description: Working and finished also filter terminal commands, including reported failures.

schema.label: Agents · Alert when an agent needs you
schema.description: Notify when a supported agent reports a permission request on another workspace. Alerts pause during screen sharing.

schema.label: Agents · Show what the agent asks
schema.description: Off keeps the question's words out of the alert, the hover card and the switcher (they only say that it needs you).

schema.label: Agents · Hide names while sharing the screen
Activity · Terminal command status
schema.description: Show sampled build, test and long commands. A shell hook is required for pass/fail.

schema.label: Activity · Unread counts
schema.description: Show counts from recognised window titles. Empty turns this off.

schema.label: Hover & switcher · Hover card
schema.description: What is open on a workspace and why it has its name.

schema.label: Hover & switcher · Git line in the switcher
Hover & switcher · Recent projects in the switcher
Hover & switcher · Project folders to index
schema.description: Comma-separated folders whose immediate subfolders appear in the switcher (empty turns the index off).

schema.label: Hover & switcher · Never list these folders
schema.description: Comma-separated folder patterns (* matches anything), e.g. ~/.t3/scratch/*.

schema.label: Hover & switcher · Agent command (Ctrl+G)
schema.description: What the switcher's Agent action runs in a terminal in the project's folder.

schema.label: Advanced · Room for names (% of screen width)
Advanced · Max name length
schema.description: Longer names are cut with … ("repo · label" keeps the label).

schema.label: Advanced · Long command threshold (seconds)
schema.description: Show other foreground commands after this long. Known builds and tests show as soon as they are sampled.

schema.label: Advanced · Rename delay (seconds)
schema.description: For focus and background changes only. A change in the window you're using shows as soon as Signpost sees it.

schema.label: Advanced · Name sources
schema.description: Leave empty to use every source.
